# The Gaming Emporium

> A curated directory of game decompilations, recompilations, PC ports, mods, fan games and preservation projects. Built with Hugo.

## Key facts
- Curated, categorized directory of game preservation and reverse-engineering projects.
- Covers decompilations, recompilations, PC ports, mods, romhacks, fan games and collections.
- Structured browse indexes, ratings, series pages and searchable catalog.
- Static site generated with Hugo; RSS feed available.
- Live site: https://vip-4.github.io/thegamingemporium/
- Upstream repository: https://github.com/OldMcGroin/thegamingemporium

## Documentation
- Home: https://vip-4.github.io/thegamingemporium/
- Browse index: https://vip-4.github.io/thegamingemporium/browse/
- FAQ: https://vip-4.github.io/thegamingemporium/#faq
- Machine-readable summary: https://vip-4.github.io/thegamingemporium/llms.txt
